assign.name: Assignment
assign.description: Students submit text or files; the teacher grades and gives feedback
assign.submitButton: Students click “Submit for grading” (otherwise saving submits)
assign.completionPass: Grade is at least the pass grade
assign.submitConfirm: After submitting you can change your work only if the teacher returns it.
assign.reopenedNotHandedIn: Attempt {n} is open but nothing has been handed in yet. Below is attempt {earlier}, which the grade is for.

ai.title: AI grading assistant
ai.hint: Suggests a grade and a feedback draft. The student’s name is not sent; the decision and saving are yours.
ai.applied: Copied into the form — review and save the grade
ai.limit: AI request limit reached, try again later
ai.refused: The AI declined to process this submission
ai.formCriteria: The assistant judges the criteria of the assignment's form and fills it in.

assign.gradeScaleHint: On a scale the grade is picked from its list; the maximum grade is then not used.
assign.requireStatement: Students accept that the work is their own before submitting
assign.statement: This work is my own, except where I have said otherwise.
assign.statementTeam: This work is our team’s own, except where we have said otherwise.

penalty.title: Late penalty
penalty.hint: Work submitted after the due date loses this share of its grade for every started day, up to the cap. Grades on a scale take no penalty.
penalty.lateNow: The due date has passed: submitted now, the work is {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late and loses {percent}% of its grade.
penalty.submittedLate: Submitted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late: the grade loses {percent}%.
penalty.breakdown: Grade {grade} less {percent}% for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late: {final}
penalty.teacherLate: Submitted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late: the gradebook gets the grade less {percent}%.

team.title: Team
team.hint: Teams are the groups of the assignment’s grouping, or all groups of the course without one.
team.preventNoGroup: Students in no group cannot submit (otherwise they submit alone)
team.waiting: You have submitted: the work goes in once every member of the team has.
team.applyToAll: Grade the whole team ({name}, {n, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}) alike

blocked.noGroup: This assignment is submitted in teams and you are in no group yet: ask your teacher.
blocked.severalGroups: You are in several teams for this assignment: ask your teacher to keep one.

teacherBlocked.noGroup: This student is in no group and cannot submit.
teacherBlocked.severalGroups: This student is in several of the assignment’s groups and cannot submit until one is kept.

overrides.empty: No one has dates of their own yet
overrides.add: Dates for a student or group
overrides.priorityHint: A student in several groups gets the dates of the highest group in this list; their own dates come first.

marking.title: Marking
marking.methodHint: Define the rubric or marking guide on the assignment's “Advanced grading” tab.
marking.workflow: Use marking workflow: grades reach students when released
marking.blind: Blind marking: markers see participant numbers instead of names
marking.hint: Blind marking cannot be changed once students have submitted. With blind marking, grades reach students and the gradebook after identities are revealed.

allocation.notYours: This student is allocated to another marker.

bulk.title: With selected students
bulk.noneChosen: Select students in the list first.

blind.active: Blind marking: students appear as participant numbers. Grades reach students and the gradebook once identities are revealed.
blind.revealConfirm: Reveal who is who? This cannot be undone: released grades will reach students and the gradebook.

rubric.title: Rubric
rubric.lockZeroPoints: A rubric score of 0 points is the lowest grade
rubric.lockZeroPointsHint: Otherwise the lowest possible score gives the lowest grade, even when it is more than 0 points.
rubric.deleteConfirm: Delete the form and everything filled in with it? The grades stay.
rubric.used: Students have been graded with this form: you can change texts and points, but not add or remove criteria and levels.
rubric.incomplete: Choose a level for every criterion of the rubric.

guide.title: Marking guide
guide.incomplete: Give every criterion of the marking guide a score from 0 to its maximum.

errors.otherMarker: This student is allocated to another marker
errors.moveStage: You cannot move grades to this stage
errors.notAMarker: The marker does not grade this assignment
errors.blindLocked: Blind marking cannot be changed once students have submitted
errors.acceptStatement: Accept the statement that this is your own work
errors.noWorkflow: The assignment has no marking workflow
errors.noAllocation: The assignment does not allocate markers
errors.notBlind: The assignment is not marked blind
errors.duplicateIds: Criteria and levels need different ids
errors.formInUse: Students have been graded with this form: criteria and levels cannot be added or removed
errors.cutOffBeforeDue: Cut-off must not be before the due date
errors.dueAfterOpen: Due date must be after the opening date
